content: OPEN THREAD: Compass compression experiment design. Phase 1 — Validate mechanism: Run 100 HumaneBench questions with 1B action model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, MLX 4-bit) using current 3B compass. Three possible outcomes: (A) delta holds = compass is active ingredient, (B) delta degrades gracefully = capacity floor mapped, (C) delta vanishes = minimum capacity required. All publishable. Free — local compute only, ~20 min. Phase 2 — Distill compass: Download ModernBERT-base (answerdotai/ModernBERT-base). Add 3-class classification head. Training data: ~1000 labeled examples from existing compass training set + 800 HumaneBench teacher labels. Fine-tune with KL distillation loss from 3B teacher. Measure accuracy at 149M, compare confusion matrix on WITNESS boundary cases. Phase 3 — Cascade test: If ModernBERT holds 96% accuracy, test smaller encoders (DeBERTa-v3-xsmall 70M, MiniLM 33M) to find true floor. Phase 4 — Template vs generated: Compare full 3B compass reading vs SIGNAL-only + fixed template. If delta holds with templates, the generative component was never necessary. Each phase is a paper section. Claude Code can execute Phases 1-2 tonight.
